title: Smart Tool Switcher
description: Automatically switches to the best tool based on the block you're mining. Fast, lightweight, and smart.
body:
_**Tired of manually switching tools every time you mine a different block?**_

SmartToolSwitcher does it for you — instantly and intelligently.

## ⚡ Features:
- Automatically selects the best tool for each block:
  - Shovel → dirt, sand, gravel
  - Axe → wood, logs
  - Pickaxe → stone, ores
- Works only when mining (no random switching)
- Human-like delay (10–50 ms) to feel natural
- Hotbar-only switching (no inventory mess)
- Skips switching if you're already using the correct tool
- Ignores low durability tools

## 🎮 Optional:
- Toggle the mod ON/OFF with a keybind (default: G)

## 💡 Lightweight and optimized:
- No lag
- No server impact (client-side only)

Just mine. The mod handles the rest.
